summary: The first set of release notes. Everything before this went undocumented.

changes.text: Countdown groups are now real groups: each one owns its colour, and Manage groups lets you rename, recolour and delete them.
Link a task to any URL without connecting Azure DevOps or GitHub first.
Readable web addresses for tasks, projects and habits. Links you already have keep working.
Completed and closed tasks load a page at a time instead of all at once.
Time logged on a subtask now counts toward its parent task's project, including in Insights.
The countdown page no longer scrolls sideways on a phone.
